title: Grade 8 English Curriculum — Qaflah Basic Education School
school_name: Qaflah Basic Education School / مدرسة قفلة الأساسية

units.topic: Meeting people, family, hobbies, personal information and profile writing
Daily routines, telling time, frequency and weekly habits
School subjects, timetables, classroom places, rules and school descriptions
Community, respectful descriptions, role models and assessment
Food groups, countable/uncountable nouns, some/any and healthy menus
Health problems, advice with should, clinic communication and healthy habits
Places in town, directions, transport, comparisons and local reading
Past Simple: regular/irregular verbs, questions, negatives and recount writing
Weather, seasons, clothes and Present Continuous
Yesterday: was/were, past verbs and recounting past events
My Past Story: questions, negatives, personal narrative and review
Stories and adventures: characters, setting, sequencing and story writing
Future plans, intentions, schedules and making arrangements
Everyday problems, asking for help, giving advice and problem-solving
My English portfolio, presentation, peer feedback and final assessment

student_book.learning_goal: Introduce yourself and ask/answer questions with be and question words.
vocabulary: full name, hometown, classmate, grade
student_book.language_focus_title: 2. Model dialogue: Meeting at Qaflah School
language_focus_content: Hussam: Hello! I'm Hussam. Are you new at Qaflah School?Ayman: Hi, Hussam. Yes, I am. My name is Ayman.Hussam: Nice to meet you, Ayman.Ayman: Nice to meet you, too!Hussam: Where are you from, Ayman?Ayman: I'm from Ataq, in Shabwah Governorate.Hussam: Where do you live now?Ayman: I live near Qaflah.Hussam: Welcome to Qaflah! I'm from Shabwah, and I live in Qaflah.Ayman: How old are you, Hussam?Hussam: I'm fourteen. How old are you?Ayman: I'm thirteen.Hussam: Which grade are you in?Ayman: I'm in Grade 8. What about you?Hussam: I'm in Grade 8, too.
practise_items: 1. Complete: I ___ from Shabwah. We ___ classmates.
2. Ask your partner: What is your name? Where are you from? Where do you live?

practise_items: Hussam is a Grade 8 student at Qaflah School in Shabwah. Every morning, he wakes up at 5:30 and walks to school with Ayman. Last year, their class visited the historical museum in Ataq. They saw old pottery and learned about the history of Shabwah. This Friday, Hussam is going to join a volleyball practice at 3:30. He is also going to read an English story on Saturday.

Answer in complete sentences (2 marks each): a) Where does Hussam study? b) Who walks to school with him? c) What did the class see at the museum? d) When is volleyball practice? e) What is Hussam going to read?
2. Vocabulary & grammar — 10 marks

Circle or complete (1 mark each): 1. A person who helps sick people is a (doctor / farmer). 2. How (much / many) water do you drink? 3. You (should / shouldn’t) shout in the library. 4. Yesterday, we (go / went) to the market. 5. Look! It (is raining / rained) now. 6. I am going to (study / studied) tomorrow. 7. The bank is ______ the post office. (opposite / eat) 8. She ______ two brothers. (have got / has got) 9. Can you swim? — Yes, I ______. 10. He ______ play chess, but he cannot drive a bus.
3. Functional communication — 10 marks

Complete the dialogues (2 marks each): a) A: Excuse me, where is the clinic? B: Go ______ and turn ______ at the market. b) A: Can you help me, please? B: Of course. Let me ______ you. c) A: Would you like a bottle of water? B: Yes, please. I’d like ______ cold water. d) A: I have a headache. B: You should ______ and tell an adult. e) A: Are you going to study tonight? B: Yes, ______ ______.
